verdict.rationale: Oneleet ships its own auditor-facing surface: a dedicated "Oneleet Auditor API" with 25 paths and its own interactive reference. That shows auditors are meant to interact with the platform directly, but nothing documents a scoped in-app auditor view of controls and evidence, or how it replaces emailed PDFs. Custom RBAC roles are a general building block and earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented in-platform auditor role or portal, scoping of the auditor view to controls and evidence, an auditor review or request workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my auditor works directly in the platform — a scoped auditor view of controls and evidence replaces email threads of PDFs
